07/08.05.2025: Heard the parties.

This is an application filed by the petitioner praying for grant of anticipatory bail in terms of Sections 482 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, as the petitioner has been allegedly implicated in a criminal case registered under Section(s) 376, 385, 386, 120B IPC, Section 4 of POCSO Act and Sections 67A and 66E of the Information Technology Act, in connection with Daltonganj Town P.S. Case No. 52 of 2024 (POCSO Case No. 27 of 2024), pending in the Court of learned Exclusive Special Judge, POCSO Act, Palamau at Daltonganj.

entities.text: Court of learned Exclusive Special Judge, POCSO Act, Palamau at Daltonganj
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It has been submitted that the process under Section 82 Cr.P.C has been issued in this case.

It is also submitted that a Criminal Misc. Petition, challenging the process issued under Section 82 Cr.P.C,
has been filed, which is pending before this Court.

As process under Section 82 Cr.P.C has been issued and the same has been challenged by way of filing a Criminal Misc. Petition, thus this application for grant of anticipatory bail is not maintainable, at this state.
Accordingly, this anticipatory bail application is dismissed as not maintainable.
